title: trichorhiza teretifolia
intro: Trichorhiza teretifolia, commonly known as the Tibetan rhodiola, is a plant species belonging to the Saxifragaceae family. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to promote overall well-being and alleviate stress, anxiety, and fatigue, due to its numerous health benefits. Its therapeutic actions include adapting to stress, improving cognitive function, and enhancing physical performance. The bioactive constituents of Trichorhiza teretifolia include triterpenoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
